'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)|War in Afghanistan]]
**[[Taliban insurgency]]
***The [[Taliban]] takes control of several further [[districts of Afghanistan|districts]] overnight as [[Afghan National Army|Afghan troops]] abandon their posts and flee into neighboring [[Tajikistan]] via [[Badakhshan Province]]. The [[State Committee for National Security (Tajikistan)|State Committee for National Security of Tajikistan]] reports that more than 300 Afghan troops crossed the [[Afghanistan–Tajikistan border|Tajik border]] as Taliban spokesperson [[Zabiullah Mujahid]] confirms that most of the territory was gained without a fight. [https://apnews.com/article/joe-biden-taliban-afghanistan-a554e1731c767b5ffaf09fb98c81bc7e (AP)]
**[[Withdrawal of United States troops from Afghanistan (2021)|Withdrawal of United States troops from Afghanistan]]
***Taliban spokesperson Suhail Shaheen warns that all foreign troops must leave [[Afghanistan]] before a [[NATO]] deadline on September 11 amid reports that the [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. military]] plans to keep 1,000 troops in [[Kabul]] in order to protect both its [[Embassy of the United States, Kabul|embassy]] and the [[Hamid Karzai International Airport]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-57714808 (BBC News)]
*[[Mali War]]
**Four [[Malian soldier]]s are killed in an [[ambush]] on their patrol. No group claims responsibility for the attack, which comes as [[France]] resumes joint military exercises with members of the [[Malian Armed Forces]], which had been suspended following the [[2021 Malian coup d'état|coup d'état]] this year led by Colonel [[Assimi Goïta]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/mali-says-four-soldiers-killed-ambush-by-suspected-militants-2021-07-04/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2021 Philippine Air Force C-130 crash]]
**Fifty people are killed and 49 others are injured when a [[C-130]] [[transport plane]] of the [[Philippine Air Force]] carrying 92 passengers and attempting to land at an airport in [[Jolo, Sulu|Jolo]], [[Sulu (province)|Sulu]], crashes in the nearby town of [[Patikul]]. Among the dead there are three civilians on the ground; four more are among the injured. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-57711597 (BBC News)]
*[[2021 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Elsa|Tropical Storm Elsa]] passes through the [[Caribbean]], downing trees and blowing off roofs, killing two people in the [[Dominican Republic]] and one in [[Saint Lucia]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/7/3/dominican-republic-and-haiti-brace-for-tropical-storm-elsa (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2021 Atami landslide]]
**Twenty-three people are rescued from their ruined homes after a landslide struck [[Atami]], [[Japan]]. Two more people are found dead, bringing the death toll to 4. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/7/5/some-1000-people-search-mud-for-survivors-after-japan-landslide (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Surfside condominium building collapse]]
**The remainder of the [[Surfside, Florida|Surfside]] condominium is demolished. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/wireStory/demolition-crews-move-condo-tower-amid-storm-fears-78656507 (ABC News)]
*A huge [[wildfire]] spreads through [[Limassol]], [[Cyprus]], killing four people and forcing the evacuation of several villages. It is described as the worst wildfire in the [[history of Cyprus|country's history]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-57710048 (BBC News)]	
*A [[mud volcano]] eruption in the [[Caspian Sea]], near an [[oil platform]] off the coast of [[Azerbaijan]], causes a massive explosion and fireball, which is seen across the region. There are no reports of injuries or damage to any oil platforms. [https://bnonews.com/index.php/2021/07/large-explosion-in-the-caspian-sea/ (BNO News)]
*[[Matīss Kivlenieks' death]]
*At Novi, Michigan on the backyard of [[Elvis Merzļikins]]' mansion, [[Matīss Kivlenieks]] sacrifices after trying to save [[Elvis Merzļikins]] and his pregnant wife when a firework explodes to Matīss' chest. The burial date was on the 21st of July at the same year. [https://www.espn.com/nhl/story/_/id/31764017/columbus-blue-jackets-goalie-matiss-kivlenieks-24-dies-tragic-accident (ESPN)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bangladesh]]
****[[Bangladesh]] reports a record 153 [[COVID-19 pandemic deaths|death]]s from [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the national death toll to 15,065. [https://www.dhakatribune.com/bangladesh/2021/07/04/highest-death-toll-of-153-recorded-as-bangladesh-crosses-15-000-mark (''Dhaka Tribune'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in India]]
****Police arrested 14 people for administering fake vaccine shots of salt water instead of the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford-AstraZeneca vaccine]] at nearly a dozen private vaccination sites in [[Mumbai]]. The organizers, including medical professionals, charged between $10 and $17 per dose. More than 2,600 people paid to receive the vaccine. [https://www.nytimes.com/2021/07/04/world/asia/india-covid-vaccine-scam.html (''The New York Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
****[[Indonesia]] reports a record 555 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, 137 of them from [[Central Java]], thereby bringing the national death toll to 60,582. [https://www.merdeka.com/peristiwa/rekor-tertinggi-sejak-pandemi-angka-kematian-covid-19-bertambah-555-pada-4-juli-2021.html (Merdeka.com)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****[[Iran]] orders the closure of non-essential businesses such as public parks, restaurants, dessert shops, beauty salons, Shopping malls and bookstores in 275 "red" and "orange" zone cities, including the capital [[Tehran]], due to the spread of the highly contagious [[SARS-CoV-2 Delta variant|Delta variant]]. [https://www.egyptindependent.com/iran-reimposes-virus-restrictions-as-delta-variant-spreads/ (Egypt Independent)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Israel]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Israel]]
*****[[Prime Minister of Israel|Prime Minister]] [[Naftali Bennett]] says that around 100,000 teenagers have received a dose of the [[COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://english.lokmat.com/health/israeli-pm-says-100000-teens-vaccinated/ (Lokmat)]
*****Bennett also announces that he has spoken with [[Pfizer]] [[Chief executive officer|CEO]] [[Albert Bourla]] about [[Deployment of COVID-19 vaccines|swapping doses]] of the [[Pfizer COVID-19 vaccine]] to other countries. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/bennett-speaks-to-pfizer-ceo-about-additional-supply-of-vaccines-to-israel/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Luxembourg]]
****[[Prime Minister of Luxembourg|Prime Minister]] [[Xavier Bettel]] is admitted to a hospital as a precautionary measure, one week after he tested positive for COVID-19. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/jul/04/luxembourg-prime-minister-xavier-bettel-admitted-to-hospital-with-covid (''The Guardian'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[Russia]] reports 25,142 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, which is the highest single-day total of new cases since January 2, thereby bringing the national total of confirmed cases to 5.6 million. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2021/07/04/russia-posts-highest-number-of-virus-cases-since-early-january-a74420 (''The Moscow Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Fiji]]
***[[Fiji]] reports a record 522 cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the national total to 6,161 cases. Fiji has seen a substantial increase in the number of cases since an outbreak occurred in April. The [[Ministry of Health and Medical Services (Fiji)|Ministry of Health and Medical Services]] also reports three deaths in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 30. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/446169/fiji-reports-record-522-new-cases-of-covid-19 (RNZ)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Politics of France]]
**The [[National Rally]] party re-elects [[Marine Le Pen]] without opposition in a bid to strengthen her candidacy for the [[2022 French presidential election]] after the party performed poorly in regional elections. The party also hosts a rally in [[Paris]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/france-far-right-national-rally-reelects-marine-le-pen/a-58154008 (DW)]
*[[Presidency of Jair Bolsonaro]], [[2021 Brazilian protests]]
**The [[Social Democratic Party (Brazil, 2011)|Social Democratic Party]]'s founder [[Gilberto Kassab]] says that there is proof "each day to impeach [[President of Brazil|President]] [[Jair Bolsonaro]]" after massive protests and Bolsonaro also announcing his candidacy for next year's presidential election. [https://noticias.uol.com.br/politica/ultimas-noticias/2021/07/04/a-cada-dia-surge-mais-municao-para-impeachment-de-bolsonaro-diz-kassab.htm (Notícias UOL)]
*The [[Constitutional Convention (Chile)|Chilean Constitutional Convention]] is inaugurated in [[Santiago]] with [[Mapuche]] representative [[Elisa Loncón]] elected as President of the Convention. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-07-04/chile-suspends-constitution-assembly-inauguration-amid-protests (Bloomberg)]
*[[Human rights in the State of Palestine]]
**Hundreds of people gather in Ramallah to demonstrate against [[President of the Palestinian National Authority|Palestinian Authority President]] [[Mahmoud Abbas]], as part of a protest movement sparked by the death of political activist [[Nizar Banat]]. [https://www.israelhayom.com/2021/07/04/hundreds-of-palestinians-demonstrate-against-abbas/ (Israel Hayom)]
